pages.rules:
Carefully study this section of the rules, and if you follow them, you have nothing to fear.

 

Fight Club is not just a game, it is your path to self-improvement and freedom. Every club member goes through trials. You must not only win fights but also find your own meaning, build communities, and help other members on their path.

 

The First Rule of Fight Club:

Tell everyone about Fight Club. Fight Club is not a game, it is your path to freedom. Share this freedom with others.

 

The Second Rule of Fight Club:

Find the meaning. Fight Club has a goal, and every player must achieve it to become a part of the club.

 

The Third Rule of Fight Club:

Be honest among your peers. Anyone who tries to deceive the club will be banned forever.

 

The Fourth Rule of Fight Club:

If you want to say something — say it. Any advice and help are welcome. Your activity is valued by the club.

 

The Fifth Rule of Fight Club:

You can quit at any moment. In the "Profile/Settings" section, there is a "Delete Account" button.

 

 

The main rules reflect the key principles: share, achieve the goal, be honest, don't stay silent, don't give up.

 

Share the freedom:

When you become part of Fight Club, you take on the responsibility for its growth. Tell others about the club, invite friends, and share your experience. Fight Club is not a solitary path, but a brotherhood united by a common goal.

 

Find your goal:

Every member of the club must strive for their personal goal. It can be winning fights, creating the strongest club, or finding oneself through participation. By achieving the goal, you will become not just a fighter but a full member of Fight Club.

 

Honesty is everything:

There is no place for deceit and lies here. Fight Club exists thanks to trust. Any attempt to deceive other members or the club will result in immediate exclusion. Honesty is the fundamental relationship between fighters.

 

Activity creates value:

Don’t be afraid to speak up, share opinions, and help others. Your activity within the club is important for its growth. Advice, ideas, and suggestions are what make the club stronger. If you see how the community can be improved, don't stay silent — your voice matters.

 

This is your choice:

You can leave at any time. It is important to understand that participation in Fight Club is a choice. If you feel that your mission is complete or you no longer wish to participate, you always have the option to delete your account in the settings.

 

Attention: Pre-launch restrictions

 

Maximum purchase:

During the pre-launch stage, each participant can purchase tokens for no more than 5,000 USD, regardless of the current token price. The token price at the start is 0.1 USD and will gradually increase. Two months before listing, it will reach 0.5 USD. After listing, the token price is planned to be set at 1 USD.

Example: If you bought tokens at the start of pre-launch at 0.1 USD per token, you will be able to purchase a maximum of 50,000 tokens for 5,000 USD. If the price rises to 0.5 USD per token, the maximum purchase will still remain at 5,000 USD, but the number of tokens you can buy will decrease to 10,000.

 

Important: This restriction does not apply to in-game activities, such as punching the bag or participating in fights. There, you can earn tokens without limits on the amount.

 

Thus, regardless of the current token price during the pre-launch stage, the maximum purchase amount remains limited to 5,000 USD until the listing, after which the token price will be set at 1 USD.

 

Minimum purchase:

The minimum amount to purchase tokens during the pre-launch stage is 5 USD.

 

Training and their limits:

Training time: Trainings are limited by a certain number of punches, calculated individually for each player. Factors such as balance, activity, number of completed tasks, and other game metrics are taken into account.

Earnings for training: Depending on the level of the punching bag, you will earn from 2 cents to 20 cents for each punch.

 

For detailed information, check out help
